classes.modeled: IRLean gives it LLVM's meaning, checked on each run or computed, as LangRef at the pin says
classes.assumed: Translated, and the model ignores it: it only guides optimization, lowering or tools, or it can't be broken in the model. The reason says which
classes.refused: The emitter refuses any function containing it, so no theorem is about one

lanes.floating point: SEM-05, running since 2026-11-09: floating-point types, operations, intrinsics, fast-math flags and floating-point attributes
lanes.external calls and globals: Running since 2026-11-09: calls to declarations, variadic calls, call-site attributes, external globals, constant expressions over them, and linkage
lanes.memory: F4, SEM-06, next in the semantics stream: refinement for functions with memory
lanes.long tail: This lane, since 2026-11-09: what the emitter refuses in LLVM's regression tests and no other lane covers

integer.says: An integer operation in IRLean/Int.lean, checked by tests/opcheck.py against Alive2 and LLVM's constant folder

vector.says: A vector of integers, lane by lane, in IRLean/Vec.lean and IRLean/Lanes.lean

control.says: Control flow: IRLean's block driver runs blocks, phis are block arguments, and branching on poison is undefined

call.says: A call to a function in the module that ir-lean translates, directly or through a pointer to one

aggregate.says: A struct is a Lean tuple, field by field

freeze.says: freeze of an integer: the value, or for poison a value the run chooses (F3, docs/refinement.md)

memory.says: Memory, in IRLean/Mem.lean. A function that uses it takes and returns a Mem, and has no Refines instance until F4

x86 dot product.says: x86's integer dot products, in IRLean/X86.lean, checked by tests/x86check.py and tests/real/x86.ll

value promise.says: A promise about a value, checked where the value is made: noundef is undefined on poison, and range, nonnull and align make it poison, as LangRef says

memory promise.says: A promise about memory, checked by Mem on each access through tags on pointers and frames for calls (#19)

progress.says: A promise to progress or to return. A run that breaks it is undefined, IRLean/Promise.lean (SEM-07)

always holds.says: It always holds in the model, which has no unwinding, threads or synchronization

call graph.says: The emitter refuses it where the call graph says it could be false, so it holds of every function translated

assume.says: llvm.assume: undefined if its condition is false, and its nonnull bundle checked

identity.says: Returns its operand: llvm.expect's hint has no meaning for a run

linkage.says: A definition that is certainly the one that runs: external, internal or private, and not one another module could replace when it's loaded

odr copy.says: A linkonce_odr or weak_odr definition translates as this translation's copy, so a theorem is about that copy. Calls to one are refused (docs/trust.md)

constant.says: A constant the model has: an integer, poison, null, zero, or a vector or struct of them

global.says: A global this module defines, with its initial bytes, in Mem

alias.says: An alias the linker can't replace, read as what it names, which is how LLVM strips it: Value::stripAndAccumulateConstantOffsets looks through no interposable alias

hint.says: Only changes how code is optimized, inlined, laid out or lowered, not what a run does

abi.says: Only says how a target passes the value, not what it is

calling convention.says: Only says how arguments and results are passed. The caller's and the callee's have to match, or LangRef makes the call undefined, and ir-lean refuses a call where they differ

debug.says: Debug information, which has no meaning for a run

profile.says: A profile, a branch weight or a hint for a tool, with no meaning for a run

target setting.says: A setting for the backend or a sanitizer, with no meaning in LangRef for a run of this function

symbol metadata.says: Metadata on a function or a global that names, types, groups or places it for the linker, CFI or tools. The emitter doesn't read metadata on functions or globals. None says what a run does, apart from absolute_symbol, which narrows where a symbol is: a theorem holds for every address the model allows, which includes those

string on a value.says: A string attribute on a parameter or a return value. LangRef gives string attributes no meaning; targets read them as settings

tail call.says: tail and musttail also promise the callee doesn't touch the caller's allocas, which the model doesn't check. A function without memory has none, and for one with memory this is an assumption until F4

upgraded debug.says: LLVM's IR reader turns calls to it into debug records, which the emitter doesn't read

upgraded.says: LLVM's IR reader rewrites calls to it as instructions the model has, so the emitter never sees the intrinsic

verifier.says: Only on an intrinsic's declaration, where it says an argument has to be a constant, which LLVM's verifier checks. Anywhere else the verifier rejects it

intrinsic operand.says: Only an operand of an intrinsic, whose own class covers it

data layout.says: A data layout the model reads the facts it uses from: 64-bit pointers and indices, and little-endian

external.says: A call to a declaration, an external global, a call-site promise or a linkage the model can't trust

objc.says: The Objective-C runtime's functions, which are calls outside the module

memory model.says: Memory the model doesn't have yet: aliasing and invariance promises, masked and element-wise accesses, provenance casts, and object sizes

scalable.says: Scalable vectors, llvm.vscale and what depends on them

vector gap.says: A vector form or operation the emitter doesn't translate yet

integer gap.says: An integer operation the model doesn't have yet

x86.says: An x86 intrinsic. The pure bit functions among them are the long tail's to model, and the rest stay refused by name

layout.says: A data layout, an address space or a vector of pointers the model doesn't have yet

exceptions.says: Exception handling: invoke, landingpad, resume and the funclet instructions

aggregate gap.says: An aggregate form the emitter doesn't translate yet

calling convention mismatch.says: A call whose calling convention isn't the callee's, which LangRef makes undefined, refused until modeled so

attribute review.says: An attribute the long tail is reviewing, to accept where it has no effect on a function without memory

metadata review.says: Metadata the long tail is reviewing, to accept where it has no meaning for a run, or model

nondeterministic.says: An intrinsic whose result the compiler chooses, such as llvm.is.constant, to model as a choice through IRLean.Choice

identity gap.says: An intrinsic that returns its operand or does nothing, to model

trap.says: A trap, to model as a stop

undef.says: undef stays out of the model, by the maintainer's decision of 2026-11-09

concurrency.says: Atomics, fences and volatile accesses, SEM-09, which waits on F4

other target.says: Another target's intrinsic, which nothing in the model covers

coroutines.says: Coroutines, which nothing in the model covers

gc.says: Garbage collection and statepoints, which nothing in the model covers

instrumentation.says: Sanitizer and profiling instrumentation, which nothing in the model covers

machine.says: Machine state: frame and return addresses, registers, counters, stack saves, trampolines, hardware loops and caches

asm.says: Inline assembly, which nothing in the model covers

convergence.says: GPU convergence control and tokens, which nothing in the model covers

pointer authentication.says: Pointer authentication, which nothing in the model covers

cfi.says: Control-flow integrity checks, which nothing in the model covers

deoptimization.says: Deoptimization, guards, patchpoints and stack maps, which nothing in the model covers

token.says: Tokens, which only the constructs above make

variadic.says: Variadic functions: their definitions, va_arg and the va_ intrinsics, which nothing in the model covers. Calls to variadic declarations are the external calls lane's

progress effect.says: llvm.sideeffect, which LangRef makes observable progress, and the model has no observable effects, so a loop calling it would be undefined under a promise

not in IR.says: Can't be written in IR at the pin: it's internal to LLVM's passes or gone from the IR format, so the emitter never sees it

promise.says: A promise the model doesn't check, and no lane plans to

not planned.says: Nothing in the model covers it, and no lane plans to
